explanation: Compared with arXiv:math/0703548 Theorem 0.2(ii) and the remark that for R=Z, K̃_0(ZG)=0 holds if torsion-free G satisfies Farrell-Jones with coefficients in Z. The conclusion (every f.g. projective ℤ[G]-module is stably free) is equivalent to K̃_0(ZG)=0. Documentation point: the source states this as a theorem conditional on Farrell-Jones, whereas the Lean statement drops that hypothesis and asserts the unconditional open conjecture. It is the classical K̃_0 vanishing conjecture, and the docstring explains the relationship.
